the role of monocyte activation by OK‐432 in cancer therapy.
the mechanisms of OK‐432‐induced MO activation.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

MOs stimulated by OK‐432 secrete less IL‐6/TNFA than MOs stimulated by LPS, and that MOs stimulated before isolation from blood by LPS secrete more IL‐6/TNA‐α than MOs stimulated before blood isolation by OK‐432.

MOs are important for the immune response to the biological response modifier OK‐432, and that the MAPK p38 pathway is important for OK‐432‐stimulated MO cytokine secretion, whereas the MAPK ERK and JNK pathways are not.
OK‐432 stimulation of MOs is dependent on MEK, p38 and to some extent p38 phosphorylation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

MAPK p38 and ERK phosphorylation are important for OK‐432‐induced MO IL‐6 and MO TNF‐α production, and that the MAPKs ERK, JNK and p38 are differentially activated following OK‐432 stimulation of MOs.
